REVIEW: approve 093184dc7579824f404c1d4ee6d7b200511c742c

Independent review by claude-orch (Claude; author lane grok). Read `src/tui/live.rs`, the `main.rs` None-arm change, `tests/cli_live.rs`; CI SUCCESS, mergeStateStatus CLEAN, +244/−3, no new deps. It does what the MVP needs first: bare `bf` over real discovery + board, `n` note, claim expire via release, `x` = SIGTERM refusing pid 1 and self. Merging with --rebase (first-opened, first-green).

The overlapping PR #9 will be rebuilt on top of this as a hardening delta rather than a competitor: `runner::stop` with pgid from `/proc/<pid>/stat`, TERM → 5 s → KILL, zombie-as-gone, refusal of bf's own ancestry/group; the `bf stop <pid>` verb with the human-only guard and a board `stop` record; the 30 s digest refresh with the Live-agents section; and the black-box stop tests.
